Method of Attack: Exploits vulnerabilities in AMD SEV-ES and SEV-SNP technologies to revert modified cache lines to their stale state, enabling privilege escalation and remote code execution.
Discoverer: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security
Impacted Systems: 1st Gen AMD EPYC Processors (SEV and SEV-ES)
2nd Gen AMD EPYC Processors (SEV and SEV-ES)
3rd Gen AMD EPYC Processors (SEV, SEV-ES, SEV-SNP)
Attack Vector: Memory writes targeting cache lines to revert them to a stale state, enabling manipulation of authentication variables and return addresses on the stack.
